basics.name: Alain FAHS
basics.label: Postdoctoral Researcher
basics.summary: Postdoctoral researcher specialized in HPC, machine learning, and computational physics, with experience in Python, CUDA, and molecular simulations.

work.name: CReSTIC Lab, University of Reims
work.summary: Parallelized Python codes using CUDA and Slurm in HPC environments. Developed machine learning models for real-time fault and anomaly detection in automated systems. Integrated optimized Python models into production pipelines for inference.
highlights: Parallelized Python codes with CUDA and Slurm
Machine learning for real-time fault detection

work.name: Constellium and SIMaP Lab
work.summary: Used HPC tools (VASP, LAMMPS) to study aluminum alloys. Developed Python scripts to apply machine learning to liquid aluminum simulations. Post-processed simulation data using Bash scripting. Collaborated with industrial casting team.
highlights: HPC simulations with VASP and LAMMPS
Applied machine learning to materials science

work.name: Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier University
work.summary: Developed custom C++ and Fortran90 codes to study atomic vibrations in MOFs and spin crossover materials. Performed molecular dynamics simulations using LAMMPS on multi-CPU systems. Modeled thermodynamic and vibrational properties at the nanoscale.
highlights: Custom code development in C++ and Fortran90

work.name: Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier University
work.summary: Delivered 64 hours of theoretical and 64 hours of practical courses in fluid mechanics to first-year university students.

education.summary: Computational modeling of surface/interface effects on spin transition materials.
Specialization in Advanced Materials for Nanoscience and Energy.
